name: cards-grid
description: A grid of cards with an optional heading/intro and repeatable card items (image, image alt, richtext), offering five style variants (solutions, product lines, insights, simple 4-up, and borderless features) laid out as a responsive multi-column grid.

contentPattern.structure: Row 0 is a heading/intro panel; each subsequent row is one card with an image cell and a text cell (eyebrow/tag, title, description, optional link or badge)
